meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会直接从 .env 文件读取 API 密钥或 OAuth 令牌，不再经过 OneCLI 网关。容器启动时，凭证作为环境变量注入，Claude 原生使用。
howto.when: 当你在 .env 中设置 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true 并配置了 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 或 CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN 时触发。每次容器启动时生效。

say.text: 帮我检查 .env 中的 API 密钥是否有效。
say.note: Claude 会读取 .env 中的凭证并验证。

say.text: 用我的 Claude Pro 订阅令牌启动容器。
say.note: 需要先运行 claude setup-token 获取令牌。

say.text: 切换到自定义 API 端点 https://myapi.com。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude reads API key or OAuth token directly from .env instead of using the OneCLI gateway. Credentials are injected as environment variables into the container, which Claude uses natively.
howto.when_en: Triggered when NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true is set in .env along with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN. Applies each time a container starts.

say_en.text: Check if the API key in .env is valid.
say_en.note: Claude reads the credential from .env and verifies it.

say_en.text: Start the container with my Claude Pro subscription token.
Switch to custom API endpoint https://myapi.com.
